svg.text: fd11_be_mispredict: the backend redirect at cyc 86
A resolves not taken in pass 2. The redirect names FTQ entry 7. The history pointer and the RAS pointers change at cyc 86, and fetch restarts at cyc 89.
before the redirect, or wrong path
Addresses are 0x8000_0xxx. Signal paths are under tb.dut unless they start with tb. Empty cells: the signal is deasserted, or its
payload is not valid. ftq_ifu_idx and ftq_ifu_start_pc are shown in cycles with ftq_ifu_req_val and ftq_ifu_req_rdy asserted.
A column is the interval with tb.cyc at its value. The redirect rises one time unit after the marker of cyc 85, so it
fills column 85, and the marker of cyc 86 is the first to show it.
